findings.title: Removing `findMany` breaks existing service callers
findings.body: This replaces the public `findMany` method with `getBaseConditions`, so callers that use `InsightsBookingService.findMany()` can no longer compile or run. The PR description says the service is being converted to raw SQL, but it does not identify a migration of those callers. Preserve the method with a raw-query implementation or update all callers and their contract before removing it.
